instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Ask the same set of questions about every one of these lines or records, all at once, with my classifier model", and give it model (the model's value: `classifier` names the family (questions-first-decider) and `weights` says where they are ({"folder"} or {"hugging_face": {"repo", "revision"}}), made ready on this Mac by tool:get-a-classifier-ready-on-this-mac); questions ({question id: {type: choice|score|noul, instructions, criteria?}}); settings (layout, dtype, tokens_per_batch, max_state_tokens); states (a list of {id?, state}). Your AI reads them from your lists first.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:answer-questions-about-many-states and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: {"result": {"status", "states_done", "states", "classifier_answers_as", "seconds", "answers": [{"index", "id"?, "answers"}]}} or {"error": "what to change"}.
4. It reads and writes nothing in your records; its answer is the whole result.
